title: Native-resolution streaming DINOv2 extraction + fixed-penalty ridge comparison
question: At native resolution (224, the model's input), what are the honest per-domain 345-way numbers for ms-only / dino-only / hybrid, scored against the M229 deployability ladder?

corpus.note: image_size 32 is only for the _load_corpus digest gate (the sealed subsample); the extraction streams the NATIVE-resolution parquet and resizes to 224

extraction.note: streamed from the parquet repository row groups; per-image PIL decode+resize on a thread pool, GPU forward; ONLY features are persisted (the registered streaming rule)

anchor.source: the sealed ms full-train penalty-1.0 aggregate

interpretation_registered_before_running.g1_fail: VOID - the ms anchor must reproduce at 1e-9
interpretation_registered_before_running.g2_fail: VOID - the schedule permutation must reconstruct the label file byte-exactly or the features would be misaligned
interpretation_registered_before_running.per_domain_reading: each arm's per-domain table is scored against the M229 ladder (easy >= 80, middle 50-60, infograph 30-40 first); no test-set lambda selection - all three penalties reported
